about_the_game:
Dive even deeper into the world of Dream Pinball 3D! Expand your Dream Pinball 3D experience with the Digital Deluxe DLC – a must-have collection for every true pinball fan!

Discover fascinating background stories, expert insights, and exclusive extras that bring the world of pinball to life beyond the tables.

Included Content:

  • Pinball Magazine (PDF) – Available in English, German, and Russian, featuring:

    • A complete A–Z Pinball Encyclopedia

    • The history and evolution of pinball machines

    • Tips & tricks from professional players

  • 15 Full HD Wallpapers featuring artwork and designs from Dream Pinball 3D

  • Double-sided Poster (PDF, 59.4 × 83.9 cm) – with detailed descriptions of all six pinball tables

  • Multilingual Glossary in German, English, and French

All content is provided in PDF and image formats.
